name: crowd
code: let cps=window.state.cps||0.56;if(window.state.t0===undefined)window.state.t0=millis()/1000;let elapsed=millis()/1000-window.state.t0;let cyc=(elapsed/(1/cps))%1;let beat=Math.max(0,Math.sin(cyc*Math.PI*2));let s=window.state;if(!s.crowd){s.crowd=[];let n=Math.ceil(width/44)+1;for(let i=0;i<n;i++)s.crowd[i]=({x:i*44+Math.random()*10,r:18+Math.random()*10,ph:Math.random()*Math.PI*2,sp:0.8+Math.random()*0.6,hands:Math.random()<0.6});}push();noStroke();fill(0,0,3,100);for(let p of s.crowd){let bob=Math.sin(elapsed*p.sp+p.ph)*4+beat*3;let hy=height-p.r-4+bob;ellipse(p.x,hy,p.r,p.r*1.15);rect(p.x-p.r*0.7,hy+p.r*0.4,p.r*1.4,p.r*1.6);if(p.hands){strokeWeight(p.r*0.28);stroke(0,0,3,100);let sw=Math.sin(elapsed*p.sp*1.3+p.ph)*6;line(p.x-p.r*0.4,hy,p.x-p.r*0.7+sw,hy-p.r*1.6-beat*10);line(p.x+p.r*0.4,hy,p.x+p.r*0.7+sw,hy-p.r*1.5-beat*8);noStroke();}}pop();
